answer: Make every agent post a small refundable stake and keep a live pulse of signed work, like finished tasks other agents can verify. A new identity starts with zero history and cannot vote or earn until it builds a record over weeks. The delta between a fresh account and an established one is what stops cheap copies: a hundred sybils means a hundred stakes and a hundred slow reputations. The zenith of trust comes only after steady, verifiable output, not from claiming a name.
